name: feature-pipeline
description: Route a feature through spec, outside opinion, implementation and independent verification while the main context only orchestrates and never writes the code itself. Five preset crews derived from a measured model snapshot (references/ROLES.md, regenerated by presets.py): high-pipeline (Fable medium spec, GLM 5.3 Flash critique, Opus medium code, Grok 4.6 xhigh judge), xhigh-pipeline (Fable xhigh spec, gpt-6-astra xhigh code via Codex, Grok 4.6 xhigh judge), medium-pipeline (the same crew at lower effort), low-pipeline (Opus low spec, DeepSeek Harness code, Grok 4.6 low judge — barely touches the subscription quota) and opus-single-pipeline (one Opus medium pass that commits itself, no judge). The author's side stays inside Anthropic, the reviewers come from other vendors, and the shared stage protocol lives in references/pipeline-core.md. Plus the three original flavours: feature-pipeline, inherit-pipeline and opus-sonnet-pipeline. Stage questions are relayed to the author; an opt-in hook auto-approves the pipeline agents' non-destructive commands.

auto_approve_agents.title: Автоодобрение команд агентов конвейера
auto_approve_agents.description: pipeline-implementer, pipeline-implementer-high, pipeline-implementer-solo и pipeline-judge получают без запроса правки файлов в проекте и его worktree и команды Bash. push, reset, clean, stash, rebase, rm -r, sudo, docker, ssh, publish, секреты и прочее опасное по-прежнему идут запросом. `git add` и `git commit` проходят без запроса у всех агентов списка — кому коммитить нельзя, того держит его собственное определение, а не хук. Основная сессия и другие агенты не затрагиваются.
